name: Avero
oneLiner: Hospitality analytics software that turns POS and operational data into sales, labor and server-performance reporting for restaurant groups.
bestFor: Full-service and fine-dining restaurant groups that want shift-, server- and manager-level sales accountability across several venues.
features: Pulls POS and operational data into one reporting layer for multi-venue groups
Sales reporting broken down by shift, manager and server
Server performance scorecards and benchmarking to coach front-of-house staff
Revenue and guest count trend analysis across locations
Mobile app for managers to check performance away from the office
POS integrations, including Toast (Avero joined the Toast partner ecosystem in 2018)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Avero does not publish prices.
